changes: One toolbar replaces the two top rows, giving the canvas more height. In the editor, the file name and saved state are in the status bar.
Graphite Night is a new dark finish in Settings, alongside the three light ones.
Graphite Night fixes: the Shapes and Stamps pickers, callout and magnify shapes and the in-place text bar now use dark backgrounds.
Drop an image or project on the window to open it. An empty editor offers Open, Capture and Paste.
Capture Now is redesigned and about a third smaller, with four themes in Settings: Midnight, Ember, Aurora and Porcelain. The Capture view and the capture overlay follow the chosen theme.
Help for Capture Now controls appears in the panel header instead of popups. Segmented controls step with the arrow keys.
macos: The macOS top MyImage menu opens the same About dialog as the in-app menu, with What’s New and Check for Updates actions.
Check GitHub for a newer Mac version and build, then open the matching Mac download.
windows: Store-installed copies check Microsoft Store for updates available to this installation. Open the Store to update.
